test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'**

Droughts effect water supply in Southern/Spain, which is increasingly turning towards/ seawater desalination to meet its water needs.

options.text: Droughts effect water supply in Southern
Spain, which is increasingly turning towards
seawater desalination to meet its water needs.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"Droughts effect water supply in Southern."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"effect"** of the sentence.
 
• The correct word is **"affect"** instead of **"effect"** as **"affect"** means to produce a change or influence something while **"effect" **means to bring about a result.
 
• **"Droughts"** is a plural noun and requires a plural verb **"affect" **which is a singular verb.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Droughts **affect**__ water supply in Southern/Spain, which is increasingly turning towards/ seawater desalination to meet its water needs. *
